    "Advanced segmentation or automation can sometimes be less intuitive.",

  "overall_experience": "This owner of a small building materials company found Mailchimp to be a highly effective tool for their email marketing needs over two years. They appreciated its user-friendly interface for designing, sending, and tracking marketing emails, which was crucial given their limited resources. While generally satisfied, they likely experienced some minor frustrations with more advanced features or the cost scaling as their business grew."
